g.text: Check image layout before interpreting the condition difference
Each bar spans the exported detections of one section. Coordinates have not been aligned or rescaled.
Condition and left/right layout coincide in every panel. This is a review priority, not proof of an artifact.
Review image assembly, illumination/background correction and detection thresholds. Bar envelopes are not tissue masks; shared image IDs are not matched trials.
